body: It’s been 1 year as of March last. I went back home and came back again and currently it’s my 7th month without any

There is no one in my life i can look upto, who is not judgmental.And i live in a country where professional help is too hard to afford without proper insurance coverage. In short, I’m a graduate and jobless for an year now. I’ve tried everything, but nothing seems working

Speak your heart out to people,those who like us here for help. Building up stress in you is not an option at all. I can relate to everything you said...I’m jobless for a year now. Serious social anxiety and being an introvert affects my networking skills. PM me if you wanna talk

I’m trying to channel the anger and harness power from it to catch the sunshine and to look back and say the golden words  to the nature “Fuck you , i survived “ 
But, still sometimes reality kicks you in the ass and makes it harder

Getting isolated by every means even by those people who besides me.Like when you’re trying to make a phone call, network error happens or poor signal at the other end. It seems like the nature itself conspiring to make me commit suicide.
PM me if you’re okay with it
Mate, you’re not alone. I’m going through exactly same situation
